SO3723 'adenylylsulfate kinase' (CysC, next to SO3726/SO3727 sulfate adenylyltransferase) is the specific catalyst; SO2618 'ATP-binding protein, Mrp/Nbp35 family' (RefSeq ApbC [4Fe-4S] cluster scaffold) is an Fe-S carrier, not an APS kinase.
SO1258 'adenylosuccinate synthetase, putative' and SO3937 PurA 'adenylosuccinate synthetase' are same-name paralogs.
SO0278 'argininosuccinate synthase' (ArgG) is the catalyst; SO0279 'argininosuccinate lyase' (ArgH, EC 4.3.2.1) catalyses the following step, a different activity, and is not a subunit of ArgG.
Both SO2767 (AsnB) and SO3175 are annotated 'asparagine synthetase, glutamine-hydrolyzing'; same-name paralog, kept despite the polysaccharide-cluster context of SO3175.
All four alternatives are annotated aspartokinases (ThrA SO3415, MetL SO4055, LysC-type SO3427 and SO3986); genuine isozymes.
SO0191 and SO1655 are both annotated 'cysQ protein' (3'(2'),5'-bisphosphate nucleotidase CysQ); same-name paralogs.

SO0486 'copper ABC transporter, periplasmic copper-binding protein', SO0487 'copper ABC transporter, ATP-binding protein' and SO0488 'copper ABC transporter, permease protein' are consecutive same-strand genes forming one copper-specific ABC system.
SO2903 'cysteine synthase A' (CysK) and SO3598 'cysteine synthase B' (CysM) are isozymes.
SO0756 AroG, SO1361 AroF and SO2646 AroH are all DAHP synthase (phospho-2-dehydro-3-deoxyheptonate aldolase) isozymes.
SO3646 FolA plus SO0772 SDR-family oxidoreductase that RefSeq names 'dihydrofolate reductase FolM'; compatible, broad-specificity reductase.

SO1301 'aspartate carbamoyltransferase' (PyrB, EC 2.1.3.2) catalyses a different step; SO3695 'dihydroorotase, homodimeric type' (PyrC) is the specific enzyme and SO3148 (RefSeq 'periplasmic amidohydrolase family protein') is kept as a family-level annotation.
SO2402 is 'ribosomal protein S1' (RpsA), not a catalyst; SO3529 'penicillin tolerance protein LytB' is RefSeq IspH, 1-hydroxy-2-methyl-2-(E)-butenyl 4-diphosphate reductase.
SO3817 PanE '2-dehydropantoate 2-reductase' plus SO4349 IlvC 'ketol-acid reductoisomerase', a broad-specificity NADPH reductase with known ketopantoate reductase side activity; compatible.
SO0931 'D-erythrose-4-phosphate dehydrogenase' plus SO0538 GapA glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase, a dehydrogenase that also oxidises E4P; compatible broad-specificity alternative.

SO4741 'glucosamine--fructose-6-phosphate aminotransferase (isomerizing)' (GlmS) is the glutamine-dependent enzyme; SO3506 is a stand-alone SIS-domain protein (RefSeq NagB glucosamine-6-phosphate deaminase, EC 3.5.99.6) beside NagA SO3505 in a GlcNAc catabolic cluster and lacks the glutamine amidotransferase domain.

SO1268 is annotated 'glutamine synthetase' (same-name paralog of GlnA SO4410); RefSeq calls it PuuA gamma-glutamylputrescine synthase in a polyamine cluster, but conflicting annotations do not meet the R1 bar.
Outer-membrane diffusion via three putative porins (SO0312, SO1821, SO3060); generic redundant porins, no change.
Beta-class carbonic anhydrase SO2474 OR spontaneous CO2 hydration; the chemistry is genuinely spontaneous, so no change.

No gene is annotated as L-lactate dehydrogenase (EC 1.1.2.3); SO1518-SO1521 beside L-lactate permease SO1522 carry only generic annotations (conserved hypothetical, Fe-S cluster-binding), and operon context alone is insufficient.
SO0343 (FB 'aconitate hydratase 1') is RefSeq '2-methyl citrate dehydratase Fe-S dependent AcnD' and lies in the prp operon with SO0344 'methylcitrate synthase' and SO0345 'methylisocitrate lyase'.
SO0343 (AcnD) and SO0432 'aconitate hydratase 2' (AcnB) are both aconitase-family hydratases; AcnB-type enzymes hydrate 2-methyl-cis-aconitate, so both are plausible.
No MntH/NRAMP or other manganese-specific transporter is annotated in the genome (only CorA/CorC Mg/Co and FeoAB ferrous iron systems).
SO2274 Ndk plus SO2018 adenylate kinase, a broad nucleotide kinase with known nucleoside-diphosphate kinase activity; compatible.

SO2396 is a 'conserved hypothetical protein' (RefSeq DUF2058) with no enzymatic annotation; SO4739 'naphthoate synthase' (MenB) is the specific enzyme.

No ornithine--oxo-acid aminotransferase (EC 2.6.1.13) is annotated; the only candidate is SO0617 'acetylornithine aminotransferase' (EC 2.6.1.11), a different specific activity.

SO4190 'inorganic pyrophosphatase, manganese-dependent' plus exopolyphosphatase SO2185 and SurE nucleotidase SO3435; broad phosphoanhydride phosphatases are protected.

SO3533 'riboflavin biosynthesis protein RibF' (bifunctional flavokinase/FAD synthetase) is the riboflavin kinase; SO0431 is a HAD-superfamily hydrolase (RefSeq 2-deoxyglucose-6-phosphate phosphatase YniC, EC 3.1.3.68) that cannot carry out ATP-dependent phosphorylation.

SO2262 'serine acetyltransferase' (CysE) is the specific enzyme; YP_007001387_1 is RefSeq 'O-antigen biosynthesis acetyltransferase WbnJ', a sugar O-acetyltransferase with a different substrate class.
SO1335 'thymidylate synthase' (ThyA) is specific; SO2419 is FadH, NADPH 2,4-dienoyl-CoA reductase (EC 1.3.1.34), with a different activity on acyl-CoA substrates.
SO3464 'thiamin-monophosphate kinase' (ThiL, EC 2.7.4.16) is specific; SO1531 ThiI is a thiazole/tRNA 4-thiouridine sulfurtransferase (EC 2.8.1.4), not a kinase.
SO1293 and SO4274 (RefSeq UppP undecaprenol diphosphatase) and SO4335 PgpB are all known undecaprenyl-diphosphate phosphatase types; genuine redundancy.
SO1631 PyrH plus SO2403 cytidylate kinase Cmk; both are pyrimidine NMP kinases with overlapping substrate class, so Cmk is not clearly excluded.
Only family-level 'cation efflux (family) protein' CDF genes (SO0519, SO2045, SO4475) match; no zinc-specific transporter is annotated, and CDF proteins are efflux systems.
